exposure: Use of virtual doula appointments on a digital health platform
number of virtual doula appointments completed
Platform users with a history of cesarean birth
outcome: Support in deciding a birth preference
Information about pregnancy complications and warning signs
cohort: 8,989 individuals who enrolled in a comprehensive digital health platform
finding: The completion of at least two virtual doula appointments was associated with a reduction in cesarean birth odds and an improved birth experience, particularly among Black users and those with previous cesarean births.
mod_finding: Completion of at least two virtual doula appointments was associated with a reduction in odds of cesarean birth among all users and among Black users, and completion of any virtual doula visits was associated with a reduction in odds of repeat cesarean birth.
